semantics.clock: All state updates on rising clk only
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous; priority over ena; sets pm=0, hh=0x12, mm=0x00, ss=0x00
semantics.enable: Each rising edge with reset=0 and ena=1 advances one second; ena=0 holds all outputs
semantics.rollover: 59 seconds carries to minutes; 59 minutes carries to hours; hours advance 01 through 12 then 01; pm toggles only when hour advances 11 to 12
semantics.initialization: No specified power-up values before first synchronous reset; no implicit initialization
semantics.output_timing: Registered outputs update on the accepting rising edge, with no additional latency

numeric.encoding: Unsigned packed BCD: tens in bits [7:4], units in bits [3:0]
numeric.arithmetic: Decimal increment with explicit decimal carry and clock wrap; no saturation or binary interpretation of BCD
numeric.invalid_state: Behavior of invalid or uninitialized state is unspecified; legal state is established by reset

verification.oracle: Independent integer seconds-of-day reference modulo 86400, initialized to midnight; derive 12-hour display and BCD outputs
checks: Synchronous reset does not change outputs between clock edges
Reset priority with ena both low and high
Compare every second across two full days including noon, midnight, hour, minute, and decimal digit carries
Bursty enables and reset during running operation
verification.tools: Icarus v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite shell and simulation timeouts

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before reset and invalid BCD state behavior are not specified; no additional behavior is required.
